name: Owner
summary: Owner provides AI-native commerce, marketing, and operations software for independent restaurants.
overview: Owner provides AI-native commerce, marketing, and operations software for independent restaurants.
bull_case: A vertically integrated software suite can help independent restaurants retain customer relationships and reduce dependence on third-party marketplaces.
bear_case: The company must sustain growth while competing with entrenched point solutions and restaurant technology incumbents.

intelligence.description: Owner provides AI-native commerce, marketing, and operations software for independent restaurants.
company: Owner provides an AI-native operating system for independent restaurants, spanning online ordering, marketing, and customer engagement.
It announced a $240 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation in August 2026.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Owner illustrates how vertical software companies are using AI to compete for the economics and customer relationships that previously flowed to delivery marketplaces and restaurant chains.

changed.text: Raised $240M Series D at a $2.3B valuation.

takeaways: The latest Series D valued Owner at $2.3B.
Owner said it had crossed $100M in annual recurring revenue at the time of the round.
Restaurant retention and efficient growth remain the core operating tests.
